subject: reasoning
question:
What will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation if ‘+’ and ‘−’ are interchanged and ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged?

25 − 33 × 44 ÷ 24 + 39 = ?
solution:
BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3241f28397a08c738d1c6690976929ab038f806f7c520377df60bd6a37d90e0b.png] 

Given equation: 25 − 33 × 44 ÷ 24 + 39 = ?

If ‘+’ and ‘−’ are interchanged and ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged, then the equation becomes:

⇒ 25 + 3
